name: print-social-green-glass-cards-cyrillic-marathon-cover
title: Green Glass Cards Marathon Cover
whatItIs: A black cover with a giant white Cyrillic headline behind five tilted frosted glass cards on a glowing green blur, each card holding an icon, a keyword and a small note, plus small corner labels.
whatItMeans: Frosted cards over green light feel like a modern, mindful workshop, and the huge headline gives the cover authority.
techniques: Frosted glass cards at different tilts
Green glow blur beneath the glass
Giant headline partly hidden by cards
Icon plus keyword plus note on each card
Corner labels for series and format

vocabulary.definition: A blurred translucent card over a colourful backdrop.
A coloured light blur behind translucent objects.
Small captions in the frame corners.
